header.title: Evangeliorum libri quattuor: AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Juvencus, Caius Vettius Aquilinus
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's stoa0169a.stoa002.opp-lat2, from Open Greek and Latin's CSEL (CC BY-SA 4.0), one English line for each line of the original. Only some passages are translated so far: those that the Atlas of Ancient Myth, Magic in the Ancient Texts and the demons-and-angels study cite.
header.statement: An AI-generated translation. No specialist has reviewed it.
header.availability: CC BY-SA 4.0, as its source requires: credit Open Greek and Latin's CSEL and this AI translation, and share adaptations under the same licence.

nodes.text: his mother had fulfilled, and Joseph, marvelling at everything,
they joyfully go back to their homeland and carry the boy home.
There is a people farther off, acquainted with the rising sun,
skilled at marking the risings and settings of the stars;
its leading men have held the name of Magi.
Then men chosen from there, along the long roads, to Jerusalem
come down, approach the king, and ask to be told
